newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain relaxes criteria for companies to join bourse.
newsitem.headline: Spain relaxes criteria for companies to join bourse.

text.p: Spain's Economy Minister said on Monday that the criteria companies must meet to list on the stock market would be relaxed and those that did not meet the profits threshold may still be allowed to join in certain cases.

Currently, companies must have made in the last two consecutive years or in three non-consecutive years within five years, a profit sufficient to distribute a dividend of at least six percent of their capital.
Now, Spain's stock market watchdog, the CNMV, can accept companies that can prove they will reach sufficient profit in the coming years.
Also companies that meet the above requirement as a result of a merger, split or contribution of a range of activities will be considered.
Finally, companies that are undergoing an economic restructuring or privatisation will be considered.
